candidates.change_summary: Remove the super.supportsInterface call so only the IAccessControl interface id is matched.
Remove the IAccessControl interface id check so only the ERC165 super check is performed.
Change the checked interface id from IAccessControl to IERC165.
Change the boolean operator from || to && so both checks must hold.
Replace the return expression with constant true so hasRole always returns true.
Replace the return expression with constant false so hasRole always returns false.
Negate the membership lookup so hasRole returns the opposite of the stored membership.
Return the queried role itself instead of its stored adminRole.
Always return DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE instead of the stored adminRole.
Read the adminRole from the DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE entry instead of the given role's entry.
